patterns.note: Content is organized into full-width sections, some with a light background and others with a dark background, creating clear visual breaks.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy, often paired with smaller, uppercase labels for context.
A high-contrast palette of dark blue-grey and white is used for backgrounds and text, punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon, green for calls to action and key interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while content sections simply scroll into view without complex animations or parallax effects.
Key information and feature explanations are presented within distinct, subtly rounded 'card' containers that stand out against the page background.

technique_notes: To rebuild the layout, use full-width containers for sections, alternating between a dark background for hero and footer areas and light backgrounds for intermediate content. Within these sections, content is constrained to a central maximum width. Key information is presented in card-like elements with subtle rounded corners and a slight shadow.

The typography system relies on a single sans-serif font family. Headings are rendered significantly larger and bolder than body text, establishing a clear visual hierarchy. Small, uppercase text is used for labels and secondary information. Text color adapts to the background, using white on dark backgrounds and dark grey on light backgrounds.

The motion system is straightforward: the main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that remains at the top of the viewport on scroll. Content sections are revealed by the natural scroll of the page, without any additional scroll-triggered animations like fade-ins, slides, or parallax effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with clear hierarchy, complemented by standard body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — used consistently on buttons and card-like containers.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — with airy vertical spacing in the hero section and between major content blocks, and a more balanced density within feature grids.

standout: This site stands out with its bold, almost brutalist typography for headings, which creates a strong, confident voice. The high-contrast dark blue-grey and white palette, accented by a striking neon green, gives it a modern, tech-forward feel that avoids generic corporate aesthetics.
